query: select df.data_file_id from iceberg_mirror.data_file df where df.table_id = $1 and df.end_snapshot is null and not coalesce(( select cs.max_value from iceberg_mirror.data_file_column_stat cs where cs.data_file_id = df.data_file_id and cs.column_name = 'loom_offset')::bigint < $2::bigint, false) limit 1
